text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert P-4321 fired for service "inference-gpu-pool" - region: west2a - symptom: sustained CUDA_ALLOC_ERROR / GPU memory pressure on 3 nodes. Severity: high. Auto-esc: 120s to PD escalation. Link: https://pd.example/p/4321 :rotating_light:

sam: acked. oncall here — pulling logs and triage now.

sam: quick log check:
```
kubectl logs -n infer pool-agg-7f8 | tail -n 80
# repeated: "CUDA error: out of memory"
# nvmlEvent: memory high
```

aria: rerouting traffic to dedicated-fallback-pool, initiating drain on two impacted nodes. Observing KV-cache growth on recent long-context requests.

kevin: any visible customer impact yet? 5xxs or latency spikes?

maria: metrics show error-rate spike for model text-gen-large from 03:12 -> +35% errors. Affected customers: alpha-inc, beta-labs. Raising CS notice.

sam: starting evacuate job: `sh scripts/evacuate_node.sh pool-agg-7f8` -> cordon + evict underway, restarting model-server on node.

incident-bot: PagerDuty P-4321 acknowledged by sam. Escalation suppressed. :white_check_mark:

aria: after evacs memory footprint dropped ~42% on the two nodes. One node still shows intermittent GPU driver recoveries (GPU reset). Marking for reboot if it doesn't stabilize.

kevin: I'll keep traffic rerouted. If driver resets continue, we OOS node and schedule maintenance.

maria: posting customer-facing status: "short degradation, partially mitigated by reroute; ops continuing work". :memo:

sam: follow-up action: open ticket to investigate KV-cache eviction policy for long-context workloads and consider Optimize recommendations for prefix caching / batching.

kevin: adding runbook note for this signal: CUDA_ALLOC_ERROR + nvmlEvent spike -> 1) ack PD, 2) reroute traffic, 3) cordon + evict nodes, 4) restart model-server, 5) reboot GPU if driver keeps resetting, 6) escalate to eng-runtime if recurring.

aria: handing back to rotation. Sam, you good to handoff?

sam: leaving notes in oncall doc, handing to kevin for night shift. :wave:

kevin: taking over. I'll watch for driver resets and coordinate maintenance window if necessary.

incident-bot: P-4321 closed (auto) after no further alerts. Incident summary drafted: short memory-pressure event mitigated by traffic reroute and node evacs. Postmortem link: https://confluence.example/incidents/P-4321
